themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can perform research tasks autonomously or semi-autonomously, including planning, execution, and reporting.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools designed to assist developers with writing, debugging, reviewing, and understanding code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles discussing a broad range of AI-powered tools and platforms used for various research purposes, including data analysis and insight generation.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Examines how AI is used to automate or enhance the process of testing the usability of products and interfaces.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Articles focused on comparing, reviewing, and determining the value or effectiveness of different AI tools for UX and research.

themes.name: AI-powered data analysis
themes.description: Details how AI is applied to analyze large datasets, extract insights, and identify patterns for research and product development.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Discusses how AI tools and techniques are used by product managers for tasks such as ideation, prioritization, and feature development.

themes.name: AI sentiment & feedback analysis
themes.description: Covers the use of AI to analyze user feedback, reviews, and comments to gauge sentiment and understand user opinions.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Explores how AI is integrated into the design process and research methodologies to enhance creativity and efficiency.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines the effects of AI on jobs, skills, and the overall structure of the workforce in relation to research and development roles.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
